+This is the live-episode script. It uses the calibrated static ego camera for
+object localization and records each execution under /app/output/episode.

+

+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+

+
+

+VERTICAL_DOWN = np.array([0.0, 0.70710678, 0.70710678, 0.0])
+
+
+def save_observation(r: Robot, name: str, depth: bool = True):
+    obs = r.get_obs(depth=depth)
+    for cam, frame in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f"{name}_{cam}.png")
+    for cam, frame in obs.last_depth.items():
+        np.save(OUT / f"{name}_{cam}_depth.npy", frame)
+    (OUT / f"{name}_meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+    return obs
+
+
+def ee_target(obs, side: str, xyz, quat, width: float | None = None):
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    tcp = now[16:30].reshape(2, 7)
+    widths = now[[7, 15]]
+    idx = 0 if side == "right" else 1
+    p = np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float), np.asarray(quat, dtype=float)]
+    w = widths[idx] if width is None else width
+    pair = np.concatenate([tcp[0], [widths[0]], tcp[1], [widths[1]]])
+    pair[idx * 8 : idx * 8 + 7] = p
+    pair[idx * 8 + 7] = w
+    return pair
+
+
+def move_ee(r: Robot, pose, note: str):
+    result = r.submit(
+        "ee_pose", np.asarray(pose, dtype=np.float32)[None, :],
+        video="mp4", cameras=["ego", "wrist_left"], note=note,
+    )
+    result.save(str(OUT / note.replace(" ", "_")))
+    print(note, json.dumps({k: result.meta.get(k) for k in ("done", "reason", "plan", "clipped", "control_steps_chunk")}), flush=True)
+    if result.done:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"episode ended: {result.meta.get('reason')}")
+    return result
+
+
+def stage_1():
+    r = Robot()
+    obs = save_observation(r, "initial")
+    tcp_left = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][23:30], dtype=float)
+    print("initial left tcp", tcp_left.tolist(), flush=True)
+    # Lift before changing orientation or moving across the table.

+    move_ee(r, high, "lift_left")
+    obs = save_observation(r, "lifted")
+    pose = ee_target(obs, "left", [0.6254, 0.2904, 1.02], VERTICAL_DOWN, 0.09)
+    move_ee(r, pose, "orient_left_vertical")
+    obs = save_observation(r, "vertical")
+    pose = ee_target(obs, "left", [0.46, 0.27, 1.02], VERTICAL_DOWN, 0.09)
+    move_ee(r, pose, "above_large_lid")
+    obs = save_observation(r, "above_lid")
+    print("time left", obs.meta.get("time_left_s"), flush=True)
